notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at Malik; «قال قرأت على مالك» (reading to him) makes Malik the source of the second branch (rule 5)
The shared tail «عن أبي الزبير عن جابر بن عبد الله» is written once after the last «ح»; «أبي الزبير» is kept as written, not identified
«- واللفظ له -» is a gloss, left out; Jabir is the last link, the Companion reporting the sacrifice
